sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 23

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 23:1
items.html: The main place of the worlds and their degree in their truth is as the second discernment that was on the eve of Shabbat, before the sin. At that time ZA was in the place of AA, the Nukva in the place of AVI, the world of Beriah in the place of YESHSUT, the world of Yetzirah in the place of ZA, and the four lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah in the place of the Nukva of ZA, back to back with Yetzirah; and the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah were in the six upper [Sefirot] of the world of Beriah. And there remained twenty-four Sefirot — which are the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah, the ten Sefirot of Yetzirah, and the ten Sefirot of Assiyah — empty and void and hollow of all light. But the first ten Sefirot, which are the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah and the six upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah, were in the secret of the Shabbat boundary, which is two thousand cubits; and the fourteen Sefirot after them, that is, from the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzirah and below, were outside the Shabbat boundary, that is, they were a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot. And the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah, which did not ascend to Atzilut but remained in the six upper [Sefirot] of the world of Beriah, were in the secret of the expansion of the city, for they were like a pregnant woman, whose fetus protrudes and comes out outside her body. The explanation: the city is the world of Atzilut, where all the worlds already were, and the Parsa beneath the world of Atzilut is the boundary of the city. For in the secret of the second restriction, the concluding Malchut ascended from the place of the point of this world to the place of the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf TNHY of AK; and from the Chazeh downward, which are the two lower thirds of Tifferet and NHYM, became empty and hollow space, like the point of this world (as above, Part 1, Page 889, Item 3). Thereby the two lower thirds of Tifferet, which are the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the body, became the source for the world of Beriah, NHY for Yetzirah, and Malchut for Assiyah. Therefore also now, after the emergence of the worlds BYA and their ascent to Atzilut, they became the discernment of empty void, as before the expansion of the three worlds BYA — except for the six upper [Sefirot] of Beriah, which did not become hollow and empty space, because the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah of holiness remained there. And the reason is that the world of Beriah was made from the discernment of the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the body. And although it too descended below the Parsa, nevertheless this was not because of itself, but because it is the discernment of a root for ZON. That is, Abba brought Ima out for the sake of her son, because no restriction applies to Bina at all, since she is entirely the discernment of the light of Hassadim, and restriction does not apply to the light of Hassadim, as is known. Therefore the seven lower Sefirot of Bina are always made the discernment of a belly for the impregnation of ZON. And this is what the Rav said, that these six upper [Sefirot] of Beriah, which are the seven lower Sefirot of Bina, are like a pregnant woman whose fetus protrudes and comes out outside her body. For these seven lower Sefirot of Bina are considered the discernment of a root and belly for ZON, in which, from the aspect of the body of Bina herself, she is considered completely Atzilut, for no discernment of restriction rules in the least over the light of Bina. But from the aspect of the ZON included in her seven lower [Sefirot], in the manner of a fetus in its mother's womb, she is compelled to be found outside Atzilut, beneath the Parsa. And this exit is considered in her value like the protrusion of the belly of a pregnant woman, which protrudes and draws away from the body outward; however, the protrusion is still attached to her body, and therefore it is considered like her body, although it is outside her body.
